visualCharacteristics.structure: grid of centered contributor profile cards, 4 per row on desktop (2 tablet, 1 mobile), left-aligned so a short last row leaves empty slots; each card: circular photo, name, uppercase roles line, horizontal bar of social icon links

contentPattern: Repeating rows, 2 columns: photo | text (name as heading, roles line e.g. 'Artist | Photographer | Traveler', social links as plain text links labelled Facebook / Twitter / Instagram — rendered as inline SVG icon links with the network name kept as accessible text)
